description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing in front of her painting, After a Walk Back of Mabel's, 1929 (CR680). The photograph was probably takene during O'Keeffe's 1930 exhibition at An American Place. Copy print photography by Peter A. Juley and Sons.
imageCaption: Alfred Stieglitz. Georgia O'Keeffe, 1930. copy print, 9 13/16 x 10 7/8. Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation. [2006.6.935]
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
